description: Single storey side to rear extension; Juliette balcony to first floor rear; two roof lights in front and rear roof slopes; external alterations; outbuilding with canopy at rear for use as Gym/Games room
decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoNormal">The proposed single storey&nbsp;rear extension&nbsp;by
reason of its excessive depth, width and siting in close proximity to No.
7&nbsp;Park Drive would give rise to overshadowing and an&nbsp; overbearing
visual impact to the detriment of the residential and visual amenities of the
occupiers of this neighbouring property. The proposal would therefore be
contrary to National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy D3 (D(1) and
D(11) of The London Plan (2021), the adopted Supplementary Planning Document:
Residential Design Guide (2010) and The Harrow Local Plan 2021-2041 GR1.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal">The proposed development is located within surface water zones
high and medium. In the absence of a satisfactory Flood Risk Assessment, it has
not been demonstrated that the proposed development would not exacerbate the
risk of flooding within the site or increase the risk and consequences of
flooding elsewhere, contrary to National Planning Policy Framework (2024),
Policy SI 12 of The London Plan (2021), and Harrow Local Plan 2021-2041 GR1 and
CN3.<o:p></o:p></p>
